subject.title: Enhancement: Developer experience quick wins from code analysis

question: Should model-routed `/skill` prompt rewriting emit a default operator warning, or only an explicit debug/trace diagnostic?
rationale: The remaining work adds a new operational signal rather than repairing a defined failing contract, and its default visibility determines log noise and user expectations.

options.title: Add debug or trace visibility
options.body: Record the rewrite through an existing structured debug or trace path so operators can diagnose routing without making ordinary execution noisy.

options.title: Add a default warning
options.body: Emit a concise normal-warning log for every rewrite, accepting the added noise in exchange for immediate discoverability.

recommendation.title: Add debug or trace visibility
recommendation.body: Record the rewrite through an existing structured debug or trace path so operators can diagnose routing without making ordinary execution noisy.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing maintainer-context review already identifies this exact visibility decision as the remaining blocker.
